manifest.name: dsh-custom-provider-settings
manifest.description: Global model request headers plus image input, reasoning, and DeepSeek system-role compatibility for custom providers
manifest.author: supersealwqas

bundle.text:
# Mount the host and Web client halves of the model request settings plugin.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-custom-provider-settings
      name: dsh-custom-provider-settings

readme.section: DSH 自定义模型提供方设置插件
readme.text:
中文 | [English](README.en.md)

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 网页端和桌面端增加全局模型请求头，并为用户添加的自定义模型提供方补充局部请求头、图像输入、思考等级和原生 system 角色兼容设置。插件通过 DSH 插件机制加载，不修改 Harness 源代码。

当前版本为 **0.10.0**，适配 Harness **0.2.2-rc.1** 的设置接口、网页组件和桌面通信方式。安装时分别选择网页端的 `web` profile 或桌面端的 `desktop` profile。

readme.section: DSH 自定义模型提供方设置插件
readme.text:
[v0.10.0 发布说明](https://github.com/supersealwqas/dsh-custom-provider-settings/releases/tag/v0.10.0) · [下载 0.10.0 TGZ 安装包](https://github.com/supersealwqas/dsh-custom-provider-settings/releases/download/v0.10.0/dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz)

> 全局请求头会作用于所有渠道和所有模型，包括 DeepSeek 官方、内置第三方和自定义提供方；局部请求头、模型能力和兼容性设置仍只显示在带“自定义”标记的提供方中。

- 为每个自定义提供方配置 `User-Agent` 和其他 HTTP 请求头。
- 在网页端或桌面端配置全局 `User-Agent` 和其他请求头，作为所有模型 API 请求的通用请求头。
- 为全局和局部 `User-Agent` 提供常用预设，同时保留自由输入。
- 将同一组自定义请求头用于普通模型请求和“获取可用模型”。
- 将每个自定义模型声明为仅文本或支持文本与图像输入。
- 配置模型可选择的思考等级，并把每个等级映射为 API 实际接收的值。
- 设置提供方默认思考等级。
- 为 `openai-completions` 提供方配置思考参数格式。
- 按自定义提供方管理 DSH 原生的 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole`，兼容拒绝 `developer` 消息的 OpenAI 协议第三方接口。
- 清空全局请求头后恢复 Harness 原有请求头行为。
插件会在原有的自定义提供方表单中插入请求头和模型能力配置。以下为较早版本的功能示意图；新版 Harness 的按钮和布局有所调整。红框区域展示了 `User-Agent`、其他请求头、图像输入、默认思考等级以及每个模型的思考等级映射。
启用的思考等级会出现在对话输入框中。图中提供 Default、Off、Low、Medium、High、Xhigh 和 Max，并选择了 Xhigh。

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`。网页端使用官方 CLI，桌面端使用同版本桌面程序附带的 CLI。
- 从源码打包或使用独立 CLI 时，需要 Node.js `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24.0.0`，建议 Node.js 24 LTS。
- 独立 CLI 的 `dsh plugin` 使用 pnpm 管理 profile 中的插件；桌面端请使用下文的内置 CLI。

可先在 PowerShell 中检查环境：

```powershell
node --version
npx --version
corepack enable
pnpm --version

如果 `corepack enable` 因权限不足失败，请使用管理员 PowerShell 再执行一次，或者按照 [pnpm 官方安装说明](https://pnpm.io/installation)安装。

安装、升级或卸载插件前，先退出对应的网页服务或桌面程序，操作完成后再重新启动。

从 [v0.10.0 Release](https://github.com/supersealwqas/dsh-custom-provider-settings/releases/tag/v0.10.0) 下载 `dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz`，或在 PowerShell 中将它保存到当前目录的 `dist` 文件夹：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .\dist | Out-Null
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/supersealwqas/dsh-custom-provider-settings/releases/download/v0.10.0/dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz' -OutFile .\dist\dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz
```
下方两端的安装命令都使用这个文件。手动下载时，可将安装包放入 `dist`，或将命令中的路径改为实际文件位置。

readme.section: 从源码生成安装包（可选）
readme.text:
也可以在本仓库目录执行以下命令，从当前源码生成安装包：

```powershell
npm install
npm test
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .\dist | Out-Null
npm pack --pack-destination .\dist

已下载 Release 安装包时，无需重复打包。

```powershell
npx --yes -p @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web add .\dist\dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz
npx --yes -p @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 dsh web
```

WebUI 默认监听 `127.0.0.1:3080`；使用启动时输出的链接打开页面。如果全局 `dsh --version` 已显示 `0.2.2-rc.1`，可以使用更短的 `dsh plugin ...` 和 `dsh web`。

readme.section: 安装到 Windows 桌面端
readme.text:
使用桌面程序安装目录下的 `resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`。下面以安装在 `D:\App\DeepSeek Harness` 为例，路径不同请替换为实际目录：

```powershell
$desktopCli = 'D:\App\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd'
& $desktopCli --version
& $desktopCli plugin --profile desktop add (Resolve-Path .\dist\dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz).Path
```

完成后通过桌面快捷方式重新打开 DeepSeek Harness。普通 npm CLI 不负责 `desktop` profile，不能用全局 `dsh` 代替这里的内置 CLI。

两个 profile 独立管理插件和配置。网页端安装成功后，桌面端仍需单独安装；反之亦然。若设置过自定义 `DSH_HOME`，命令与对应应用必须使用同一个目录。

readme.section: 安装到 Windows 桌面端
readme.text: `dist` 目录和 TGZ 文件已被 `.gitignore` 忽略，不随源码提交。

退出对应应用后，使用更新后的 TGZ 再次执行该 profile 的 `add` 命令即可升级，不需要先卸载。重新打包源码后，也需要重新安装安装包，再启动应用。

同版本重新打包测试时，请先给 TGZ 换一个新文件名（例如加上内容哈希），再执行 `add`；否则 pnpm 可能沿用同路径安装包的缓存。
```powershell
npx --yes -p @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-custom-provider-settings

& $desktopCli plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-custom-provider-settings
```

重新启动对应应用后，插件加入的配置区域和全局请求头覆盖停止生效。图像输入、思考等级与 `compat` 属于 Harness 原生提供方配置，可在模型设置中继续管理。

1. 打开“设置” > “模型”。
2. 在模型列表顶部的“全局模型请求头”区域填写 `User-Agent` 或其他请求头。留空表示继续使用 Harness 内置默认请求头。
3. 需要时编辑带“自定义”标记且已经包含模型的提供方，或者选择“添加模型提供商” > “自定义模型 API”并填写模型。
4. 在插件插入的“请求头”区域配置仅针对该自定义提供方的请求头；同名时由这个局部值覆盖全局值。
5. 如果兼容的 OpenAI 协议自定义提供方拒绝 `developer` 角色，请勾选“使用 system 角色发送系统提示词”。已有原生 `supportsDeveloperRole: false` 配置会自动显示为已勾选。
6. 在“模型能力”中选择每个模型的输入能力和思考能力。只有 API 和模型都支持图像输入时，才选择“文本与图像”。
7. 使用原表单的“保存”或“创建提供商”按钮。Harness 原表单保存成功后，插件会继续保存扩展字段。
8. 新建对话，选择模型；全局请求头会自动用于该模型请求。

“获取可用模型”会使用同一表单中当前填写的请求头，包括尚未保存的值。因此，必须依赖特定 `User-Agent` 或其他请求头的接口也可以正常获取模型列表。

清空尚未保存的局部请求头后再获取模型，会移除该提供方以前保存的额外头，并保留 Harness 的默认头及凭据。桌面端通过其原生通信通道完成发现，不要求启动额外网页服务。

全局请求头也会用于模型发现请求。请求头合并顺序为 Harness 默认值、全局请求头、自定义提供方局部请求头，因此局部同名字段的优先级最高。

全局和自定义提供方局部的 `User-Agent` 输入框都提供以下预设：

- `claude-cli/2.1.161 (external, cli)`
- `claude-cli/2.1.161`
- `claude-code/1.0.0`
- `claude-code/0.1.0`
- `Kilo-Code/1.0`

选择预设后会替换输入框当前内容；输入框仍然可以手动编辑，也可以填写列表之外的任意 `User-Agent`。

1. 将模型的输入能力设为“文本与图像”，然后保存提供方。
2. 使用该模型新建对话。
3. 上传一张包含唯一字符串的 PNG 或 JPEG，例如 `VISION-7392`。
4. 要求模型只返回图片中看到的字符串。

模型正确返回字符串，说明 Harness 已接受附件，并且接口成功处理了图片。这个设置只是向 Harness 声明模型能力，无法让原本不支持视觉输入的 API 或模型获得图像识别能力。

这个复选框只是 DSH 原生 pi-ai 兼容配置的 WebUI，不会由插件拦截或改写 JSON 请求体。

- 勾选：为当前自定义提供方写入 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false`。
- 取消勾选：只删除 `supportsDeveloperRole`，恢复 DSH/pi-ai 自动检测。
- 作用范围：影响当前提供方下面的所有模型，不影响其他提供方。
- 字段保留：不会删除同一 `compat` 下的 `thinkingFormat`、`supportsReasoningEffort` 等其他配置。

只有原生 pi-ai 兼容类型支持该字段的 OpenAI 协议自定义提供方才会显示此选项。

新版 Harness 将可编辑配置写入对应 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。默认位置为：

- 网页端：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`
- 桌面端：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml`

如果设置了 `DSH_HOME`，使用该目录下的 `profiles\<profile>\cordis.patch.yml`。也可以通过“设置”中的“打开配置文件”查看当前应用使用的文件。以下是配置层级示例：

```yaml
- id: dsh-custom-provider-settings
  name: dsh-custom-provider-settings
  config:
    globalHeaders:

请求头值以普通文本存入 profile 配置。API 密钥和其他秘密信息应放在 Harness 的凭据字段中，不要写进自定义请求头。旧版 `settings.yaml` 的迁移由 Harness 处理；它已不是新版的当前配置文件。

清空全局请求头会删除全局覆盖配置，并恢复 Harness 原有的请求头行为；清空某个提供方请求头只会清除该提供方的额外覆盖。

readme.section: 启动时报错 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'llm')`
readme.text: 建议将 Harness 升级到本次验证的 `0.2.2-rc.1`，按上方步骤安装插件 `0.10.0`，然后重启对应应用。插件 `0.5.0` 曾被报告在新版 Harness 中出现此错误；`0.10.0` 优先使用新版 Remote 接口，并处理旧 `connection.api` 缺失的情况，无需修改模型 JSON 或删除配置。原报告的完整旧环境尚未复现验证。参见 [Related issue #1](https://github.com/supersealwqas/dsh-custom-provider-settings/issues/1)。

readme.section: 页面没有显示插件配置
readme.text: 确认网页端安装到了 `web` profile，桌面端安装到了 `desktop` profile，并在安装后重启对应应用。全局请求头区域位于“模型”列表顶部；自定义提供方中没有模型时，不会出现可编辑的模型能力配置。旧版 0.9.0 在新版 Harness 中存在组件和设置接口不兼容，请安装 0.10.0。
先确认 Base URL、API Key 和 API 协议正确，再检查接口要求的 `User-Agent` 或其他请求头是否已经填写。插件会把表单中尚未保存的请求头一起用于本次模型列表请求。

readme.section: 对话中没有思考等级或图像上传入口
readme.text: 保存提供方后新建对话并重新选择模型。思考等级必须在对应模型上启用；图像上传还要求该模型被声明为“文本与图像”。

readme.section: 第三方 DeepSeek 接口拒绝 developer 角色
readme.text: 编辑对应的兼容 OpenAI 协议自定义提供方，勾选“使用 system 角色发送系统提示词”并保存，然后新建对话。这个设置只作用于当前提供方，官方 DeepSeek 和其他自定义提供方的消息角色保持原样。

readme.section: 接口可以使用，但复选框显示未勾选
readme.text: 重新启动应用后再打开提供方编辑页面。复选框会读取原生 `llm-pi-ai.providers.<provider>.compat.supportsDeveloperRole` 的有效值。如果 profile 配置中已经是 `false`，界面仍未勾选，网页端可强制刷新页面；桌面端请完全退出后重启，确保加载当前插件版本。

| 测试组 | 结果 | 覆盖范围 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 自动测试 | 30 项通过 | 客户端保存、设置接口、模型发现、请求头与包配置 |
| 真实 Harness 请求链 + 本地模拟 API | 20 项通过 | 多渠道请求头、system 角色、图像数据、7 个思考等级和 8 种参数格式 |
| 真实网页界面 + 本地模拟 API | 19 项通过 | 中英文界面、保存与清空、草稿模型发现、原生字段保留、模型重排/删除、刷新恢复 |
| Windows 桌面核心界面 | 10 项通过 | 表单显示、模型发现、请求头与 system 设置保存/重开/清空、原有配置保留和测试提供方删除 |
| Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` 后端回归 | 2 组各 9 项通过 | 原有 Schemastery 3.18.5，以及插件单独使用 3.19.0 的依赖组合；覆盖加载、原生 Config、无 HTTP 服务的 RPC 和请求头 |
| 真实 API 网页验证 | 15 项通过 | 实际模型发现、文本和图片对话、High 请求参数、请求头保存/清空、配置与会话刷新恢复 |
| 独立真实 API 验证 | 模型列表 + 3 次推理通过 | 文本流式回复、High 思考内容和合成图识别 |
真实网页和独立 API 验证使用 `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`。网页图片请求记录了 `reasoningEffort=high`，正确识别图形，但该次回复没有 `reasoning` 内容块；独立 API 思考测试另返回了 `reasoning_content`。桌面端验证限于表中核心设置流程，未覆盖真实模型推理或全部功能。

- 0.10.0 的本次适配与实机验证基线为 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` 的网页端和 Windows 桌面端。
- 旧版回归覆盖后端兼容性，不等同于旧版桌面界面的全功能实测。
- 本地模拟 API 验证参数和数据的实际发送；真实 API 验证限于上述接口和模型能力，不代表任意第三方模型都支持这些能力。
- 全局请求头会注入所有模型渠道；自定义提供方专属的图像输入、思考等级、兼容性设置和请求头编辑器只挂载到 Harness 报告为 `declared: true` 的提供方。
- 插件不会修改 DeepSeek 官方和内置第三方提供方的模型配置，但全局请求头仍会作用于它们的 API 请求。
- 保存插件设置时，会保留原表单管理的模型名称、上下文窗口、最大输出值和其他字段。
- 本插件通过原页面的无障碍标签定位表单，并在运行时挂载 React 控件，因此 Harness 以后修改表单结构时可能需要更新插件。
- 插件不会修改 DeepSeek Harness 源代码文件。

```powershell
npm test
node --check client.js
npm pack --dry-run
```

[中文](README.md) | English

A plugin for the web and desktop editions of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) that adds global model request headers and extends user-defined custom providers with per-provider headers, image-input declarations, reasoning-level settings, and native system-role compatibility controls. It loads through the DSH plugin system and does not modify Harness source files.

The current version is **0.10.0**, updated for the settings API, UI components, and desktop transport in Harness **0.2.2-rc.1**. Install it into the `web` profile for the browser UI or the `desktop` profile for the desktop application.

[v0.10.0 release notes](https://github.com/supersealwqas/dsh-custom-provider-settings/releases/tag/v0.10.0) · [Download the 0.10.0 TGZ package](https://github.com/supersealwqas/dsh-custom-provider-settings/releases/download/v0.10.0/dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz)

> Global request headers apply to every channel and model, including official DeepSeek, built-in third-party, and custom providers. Per-provider headers, model capabilities, and compatibility controls remain limited to providers carrying the Custom tag.

- Configure `User-Agent` and additional HTTP request headers for each custom provider.
- Configure global `User-Agent` and additional headers in the web or desktop UI for every model request.
- Fill either global or per-provider `User-Agent` fields from common presets while retaining free-form input.
- Apply the same custom headers to normal model requests and Fetch available models.
- Declare each custom model as text-only or text-and-image capable.
- Configure the reasoning levels exposed for each model and map every level to the value sent to its API.
- Set a provider-level default reasoning level.
- Configure the reasoning parameter format for `openai-completions` providers.
- Manage DSH's native `compat.supportsDeveloperRole` switch for each compatible custom OpenAI provider whose endpoint rejects `developer` messages.
- Restore the original Harness request-header behavior by clearing the global headers.

The plugin inserts request-header and model-capability fields into the existing custom-provider form. These screenshots illustrate an earlier version; newer Harness versions use updated buttons and layouts. The highlighted areas show `User-Agent`, additional headers, image input, the default reasoning level, and per-model reasoning mappings.
Enabled reasoning levels appear in the conversation composer. The example exposes Default, Off, Low, Medium, High, Xhigh, and Max, with Xhigh selected.

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`. Use the official CLI for the web edition and the CLI shipped with the matching desktop application for desktop.
- Packaging from source or using the standalone CLI requires Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`; Node.js 24 LTS is recommended.
- The standalone `dsh plugin` command uses pnpm to manage profile plugins. For desktop, use the bundled CLI described below.

Check the environment in PowerShell:

```powershell
node --version
npx --version
corepack enable
pnpm --version

If `corepack enable` fails because of insufficient permissions, run it once from an administrator PowerShell or follow the [pnpm installation guide](https://pnpm.io/installation).

Stop the corresponding web service or desktop application before installing, upgrading, or removing the plugin, then restart it when the command completes.

Download `dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz` from the [v0.10.0 release](https://github.com/supersealwqas/dsh-custom-provider-settings/releases/tag/v0.10.0), or save it into a `dist` folder under the current directory with PowerShell:

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .\dist | Out-Null
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/supersealwqas/dsh-custom-provider-settings/releases/download/v0.10.0/dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz' -OutFile .\dist\dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz
```

Both installation commands below use this file. For a manual download, place the package in `dist` or replace the command's path with its actual location.

Alternatively, run these commands in the repository to package the current source:

```powershell
npm install
npm test
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .\dist | Out-Null
npm pack --pack-destination .\dist

Skip this step if you downloaded the release package.

```powershell
npx --yes -p @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web add .\dist\dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz
npx --yes -p @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 dsh web
```

The WebUI listens on `127.0.0.1:3080` by default; open the URL printed at startup. If your global `dsh --version` already reports `0.2.2-rc.1`, the shorter `dsh plugin ...` and `dsh web` forms are equivalent.

Use `resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd` under the desktop installation directory. This example uses `D:\App\DeepSeek Harness`; replace it with your actual installation directory:

```powershell
$desktopCli = 'D:\App\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd'
& $desktopCli --version
& $desktopCli plugin --profile desktop add (Resolve-Path .\dist\dsh-custom-provider-settings-0.10.0.tgz).Path
```

Reopen DeepSeek Harness from its desktop shortcut afterward. The ordinary npm CLI does not manage the `desktop` profile; use the bundled CLI for these commands.

The two profiles manage plugins and configuration independently. Installing into the web profile does not install into desktop, or vice versa. If you use a custom `DSH_HOME`, the CLI command and its corresponding application must use the same directory.
The `dist` directory and TGZ files are ignored by `.gitignore` and are not committed with the source.

Stop the corresponding application and run that profile's `add` command again with the updated TGZ. DSH updates the installed plugin without requiring a separate removal. After rebuilding the source, reinstall the new package before restarting the application.

When repacking the same version for testing, give the TGZ a new filename (for example, append its content hash) before running `add`; otherwise pnpm may reuse its cached package from the same path.
```powershell
npx --yes -p @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-custom-provider-settings

& $desktopCli plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-custom-provider-settings
```

Restart the corresponding application to remove the plugin controls and global request-header overrides. Image input, reasoning levels, and `compat` fields are native Harness provider settings and can still be managed in the Models settings.

1. Open Settings > Models.
2. In the Global model request headers area at the top of the model list, enter a `User-Agent` or other headers. Leave it empty to keep Harness defaults.
3. If needed, edit a provider carrying the Custom tag that already contains a model, or choose Add model provider > Custom model API and enter its models.
4. In the inserted per-provider Request headers area, configure headers for that custom provider; matching local values take precedence over global values.
5. For a compatible custom OpenAI provider, enable `Send system prompts with the system role` when its endpoint rejects the `developer` role. An existing native `supportsDeveloperRole: false` setting appears as an already-checked box.
6. Under Model capabilities, choose each model's input and reasoning capabilities. Select Text and images only when both the API and model support image input.
7. Use the original Apply or Create provider button. The plugin saves its fields after the Harness form succeeds.
8. Start a new conversation and select the model; global headers are applied automatically.

Fetch available models uses the request-header values currently entered in the same form, including values that have not been saved yet. This allows model discovery to work with endpoints that require a particular `User-Agent` or another custom header.

Clearing unsaved per-provider headers before fetching models removes the previously saved extra headers while preserving Harness defaults and credentials. Desktop discovery uses the application's native transport and does not require an additional web service.

Global headers are also applied to model discovery. The merge order is Harness defaults, global headers, then custom-provider headers, so matching local values have the highest priority.

Both global and per-provider `User-Agent` fields include these presets:

- `claude-cli/2.1.161 (external, cli)`
- `claude-cli/2.1.161`
- `claude-code/1.0.0`
- `claude-code/0.1.0`
- `Kilo-Code/1.0`

Selecting a preset replaces the current text field value. The field remains editable, so any other `User-Agent` can be entered manually.

1. Set the model's input capability to Text and images and save the provider.
2. Start a new conversation with that model.
3. Upload a PNG or JPEG containing a unique string such as `VISION-7392`.
4. Ask the model to return only the string visible in the image.

A correct response confirms that Harness accepted the attachment and the endpoint processed it. This setting declares model capability to Harness; it cannot add vision support to an API or model that does not already provide it.
The checkbox is a WebUI layer over DSH's native pi-ai compatibility setting. The plugin does not intercept or rewrite the JSON request body.

- Checked: writes `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` for the current custom provider.
- Unchecked: removes only `supportsDeveloperRole`, restoring DSH/pi-ai automatic detection.
- Scope: applies to every model under that provider, without changing other providers.
- Preservation: leaves neighboring fields such as `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort` unchanged.

The control appears only for custom OpenAI protocols whose native pi-ai compatibility type supports this field.

Newer Harness versions store editable configuration in each profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. The default Windows locations are:

- Web: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`
- Desktop: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml`

With a custom `DSH_HOME`, use `profiles\<profile>\cordis.patch.yml` below that directory. Open configuration file in Settings opens the file used by the current application. The configuration structure is:

```yaml
- id: dsh-custom-provider-settings
  name: dsh-custom-provider-settings
  config:
    globalHeaders:

Header values are stored as ordinary text in the profile configuration. Keep API keys and other secrets in the Harness credential field instead of custom headers. Harness handles migration from the old `settings.yaml`; that file is no longer the active configuration store in current versions.
Clearing the global headers removes the global override and restores the original Harness request-header behavior. Clearing a provider's headers only removes that provider's extra override.

readme.section: Startup fails with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'llm')`
readme.text: Upgrade Harness to the tested `0.2.2-rc.1`, install plugin `0.10.0` using the steps above, and restart the corresponding application. This error was reported with plugin `0.5.0` on a newer Harness version. Version `0.10.0` prefers the current Remote interface and handles a missing legacy `connection.api`; changing model JSON or deleting configuration is unnecessary. The complete older environment described in the report has not been reproduced. See [Related issue #1](https://github.com/supersealwqas/dsh-custom-provider-settings/issues/1).

readme.section: The plugin settings do not appear
readme.text: Confirm that the web edition uses the `web` profile and the desktop edition uses `desktop`, then restart the corresponding application. The global header area appears at the top of the Models list; a custom provider without models has no editable model-capability settings. Plugin 0.9.0 has component and settings API incompatibilities with newer Harness versions; install 0.10.0.

Confirm the Base URL, API key, and API protocol first, then check every `User-Agent` or additional header required by the endpoint. The plugin includes unsaved header values from the active form in the discovery request.

readme.section: Reasoning levels or image upload are missing in a conversation
readme.text: Save the provider, start a new conversation, and select the model again. Reasoning levels must be enabled for that model, and image upload requires the model to be declared as Text and images.

readme.section: A third-party DeepSeek endpoint rejects the developer role
readme.text: Edit the compatible custom OpenAI provider, enable `Send system prompts with the system role`, save it, and start a new conversation. The setting is scoped to that provider; the official DeepSeek provider and other custom providers keep their existing request roles.

readme.section: The endpoint works, but the checkbox looks unchecked
readme.text: Open the provider editor after restarting the application. The checkbox reads the effective native `llm-pi-ai.providers.<provider>.compat.supportsDeveloperRole` value. If the profile configuration already contains `false` but the UI remains unchecked, force-refresh the browser page or fully exit and reopen the desktop application to load the current plugin version.
Version 0.10.0 completed the following checks on 2026-11-04. Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` was used except for the older-version regression checks. Each group covers a different scope:

| Test group | Result | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Automated tests | 30 passed | Client saves, settings API, model discovery, request headers, and package configuration |
| Real Harness request pipeline + local mock API | 20 passed | Headers across provider channels, system role, image bytes, 7 reasoning levels, and 8 wire formats |
| Real web UI + local mock API | 19 passed | Chinese/English UI, save/clear, draft model discovery, native field preservation, model reorder/delete, and reload persistence |
| Windows desktop core UI | 10 passed | Form rendering, model discovery, header/system settings save/reopen/clear, original configuration preservation, and test-provider removal |
| Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` backend regression | 9 passed in each of 2 configurations | Original Schemastery 3.18.5 and plugin-local 3.19.0; loading, native Config, RPC without HTTP, and request headers |
| Live API through the web UI | 15 passed | Live model discovery, text and image conversations, the High request parameter, header save/clear, and configuration/conversation reload |
| Direct live API checks | Model listing + 3 inference calls passed | Streaming text, High reasoning content, and synthetic-i

The live web and direct API checks used `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`. The web image request recorded `reasoningEffort=high` and identified the shapes correctly, but that response contained no reasoning block; the separate direct API reasoning test returned `reasoning_content`. Desktop verification covers the core settings flows listed above, without live model inference or a complete feature review.

- The adaptation and live-testing baseline for 0.10.0 is DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` on the web and Windows desktop editions.
- Older-version regression checks cover backend compatibility, not the full UI of the older desktop application.
- Mock API checks verify transmitted parameters and data. Live API checks cover the tested endpoint and model capabilities, without establishing support in every third-party model.
- Global headers are injected into every model channel; custom-provider image, reasoning, compatibility, and per-provider header controls mount only on providers reported by Harness with `declared: true`.
- The plugin does not modify official or built-in provider model configuration, although global headers still apply to their API requests.
- Model names, context windows, maximum output values, and other fields owned by the original form are preserved when plugin settings are saved.
- This plugin locates the original accessible labels and mounts its React controls at runtime, so a future Harness form change may require a plugin update.
- The plugin does not patch DeepSeek Harness source files.

node --check client.js
